description: Second of the Foxwatch. The Drifter walks the outer patrols alone, fringe over one eye, never in a hurry and never late. Ask him what he's watching for and he'll just smile.
name: The Drifter — Foxwatch Outrider

description: Third of the Foxwatch. The Mosaic is assembled from a thousand colored shards, every one a night the watch held the line. He wears a bow tie because even guardians dress for the occasion.
name: The Mosaic — Foxwatch Artisan

description: Fourth of the Foxwatch. The Overtime has pulled every night shift since the watch began, and it shows. He'll hold the post until relieved, then sleep standing up.
name: The Overtime — Foxwatch Nightwatch

description: Fifth of the Foxwatch. The Hearth keeps the den warm and the blankets folded. Every patrol that comes home cold finds a scarf waiting with their name stitched in.
name: The Hearth — Foxwatch Keeper

description: Sixth of the Foxwatch. The Sprout is the youngest recruit, all wide eyes and pressed shirts. The veterans tease him; the Sprout just trains harder.
name: The Sprout — Foxwatch Tenderfoot

description: Seventh of the Foxwatch. The Ranger reads trails the way others read books. Olive tunic, travel cloak, eyes on the horizon — if he's watching, the den is safe.
name: The Ranger — Foxwatch Pathfinder

description: Eighth of the Foxwatch. The Striker settled the great meadow derby with a single impossible goal. He still brings the ball everywhere, just in case.
name: The Striker — Foxwatch Vanguard

description: Ninth of the Foxwatch. Nobody remembers when the Maw joined — he was just suddenly there, grinning at the mountain passes. Intruders remember him. Briefly.
name: The Maw — Foxwatch Berserker

description: Tenth of the Foxwatch. The Siesta guards the quiet hours by example. Her safari patches are earned one nap at a time, and her coffee mug is never, ever empty.
name: The Siesta — Foxwatch Dreamer

description: Eleventh of the Foxwatch. The Mane grew his ruff on the high ridges and carries himself like it. Orange scarf, green eyes, zero doubt. Follow him or get out of the way.
name: The Mane — Foxwatch Prideleader

description: Twelfth of the Foxwatch. The Dandy is the watch's envoy to every court and caravan on the desert road. Paisley vest, perfect posture, and a deal for every occasion.
name: The Dandy — Foxwatch Emissary

description: Thirteenth of the Foxwatch. The Jubilee throws the party after every victory, balloons and all. Someone has to celebrate the wins — he's made it his whole job.
name: The Jubilee — Foxwatch Reveler
